observations: L03: مُجْمَلًا: a damma over the first mīm, a sukun over the jīm, a fatha over the second mīm and a fathatan (one thick sort, 3.2 x 2.5 pt) over the lām-alif; L13 زائدًا has the same fathatan sort.
L04: لكَىْ: a fatha over the kāf and a sukun over the final yā', which has no dots.
L06: the first «او غيرها» is set with a thin space (2.2 pt between the wāw and the ghayn; the word spaces of the line are wider).

L07: in فاطلب the lām stands 1.0 pt from the bā': its join did not print. A vertical tick (1.4 x 2.5 pt) over the lām of «الميل» (after جداول) is not a vowel sign. In تِلْقاءَه the lām printed thin and broken; a kasra under the tā', a sukun over the lām.
L08: in ميل (after فهو) the join of the mīm to the yā' did not print (a gap of 3.6 pt).
L09: أريْتك: a hamza over the alif (one mark 2.9 x 2.9 pt, no fatha) and a sukun between the rā' and the yā', taken as the yā''s.
L12: نقصته: one dot over the first letter (a nūn), two over the qāf; no sukun (زدْته on the same line has one).
L13, L16: the zero sign of the codex ({0}) under the abjad bar: a round body with a short bar on its top, as in the tables. The abjad numerals of L13–L17 are Eastern: ص 90, قف 180, رع 270, شس 360.
L15: over the tā' of the second كانت a short slanted stroke (2.2 x 1.1 pt, smaller than the fathas of the page, 3.2-3.6 x 1.8-2.2) is transcribed as a fatha.
L18: the last word كل has no shadda (كلّ earlier on the line has one).
L19: ربْع: a sukun over the bā', no damma over the rā'. In التسعين the lām stands 0.3 pt from the tā' (its join did not print) and looks like an alif.
L20, L21: إِنّها: a hamza with a kasra under the alif (one mark 2.9-3.2 x 4.7 pt).
L07: in تِلْقاءَه the hamza and a fatha over it are one sort (3.6 x 4.7 pt; a bare hamza measures 2.9 x 3.2 pt).
